Amazon Ecs Create a New Ecs Service

items.docs: Runs and maintains a specified number of instances of a task definition simultaneously in an ECS cluster. If the desired count of tasks in a service drops below the desired count, Amazon ECS runs another instantiation of the task to bring the count back up.
